title: Description: When an iRule that processes client traffic using the GENERICMESSAGE::route command is configured on a…
description: A vulnerability exists in BIG-IP systems when an iRule using the GENERICMESSAGE::route command processes client traffic. Undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to crash and restart, disrupting traffic and potentially allowing remote code execution (RCE). This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. Versions that have reached End of Technical Support are not evaluated.
